question: After removing the Ward-derived prepotential Eq.(7.10), reduce the remaining flat-FLRW scalar metric equations Eq.(7.11)-(7.15) to a minimal k>0 solver form for lambda_HL>1, keeping total gravitating stress sources arbitrary and without yet assuming that the current CLASS effective-fluid stress equals the completed-action stress.

scope.background: flat FLRW, conformal time, Nbar=a, zero background shift
scope.source_symbols: delta_mu_total, q_total, delta_p_total, Pi_total are left arbitrary
scope.A_source: delta J_A=2 delta P_A with delta P_A the ordinary-only elliptic projected density coefficient from the parent C10 source gates

acceptance: from Eq.(7.12) derive L B=[8 pi G a q_total-D(psi_prime+H phi)]/r
insert that expression into Eq.(7.13) and derive [r Eth L-2D H^2] phi=-8 pi G a^2 r delta_mu_total-D H(8 pi G a q_total)+2D H psi_prime+2r Pcal L psi
state the lapse-solve nonzero-denominator condition; in Fourier if the complete effective Eth is positive then r Eth L-2D H^2=-(r Eth k^2+2D H^2)<0 and is pole-free for k>0
solve Eq.(7.15) algebraically for delta A and verify the exact sign
substitute Eq.(7.15) into Eq.(7.14) and prove all explicit deltaA, alpha1 and Pcal terms cancel
differentiate Eq.(7.12) and eliminate L(B_prime+2HB) from the reduced Eq.(7.14)
prove psi_double_prime, phi_prime, B_prime and psi_prime cancel from the final compatibility relation
derive D(H_prime-H^2) phi + Mq_prime+2H Mq = 8 pi G a^2 delta_p_total + (16 pi G a^2/3)L Pi_total, where Mq=8 pi G a q_total
interpret the result only as an algebraic/minimal field-equation reduction; do not call the final compatibility relation redundant until compared with the completed-action conservation law
explicitly keep open the action-level mapping of S_mix contributions to delta_mu_total,q_total,delta_p_total,Pi_total and to any effective lapse kernel Eth
non_claims: does not establish the completed-action stress-source dictionary
does not identify pure-gravity Eth with the full effective lapse kernel after moving S_mix terms between sides of the equations
does not prove the final compatibility relation is automatically satisfied by the completed matter equations
does not cover k=0 or lambda=1 exactly
does not implement CLASS or change likelihood results
